usdRate.sourceName: Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina, exchange rate list no. 215
usdRate.note: Middle rate; the convertible mark is fixed at KM 1.95583 per euro under the currency board.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: Agency for Statistics of BiH (BHAS), CPI time series (PRI_01)
inflation_cpi.note: Annual CPI 6.0% in September 2026 (index 138.75 vs 130.93 a year earlier); also shown on the BHAS home page as 'Inflation (CPI) IX-2026/IX-2025: 6.0%'.

inflation_projection.sourceName: BHAS CPI time series (5-year average about 6.3% a year, Sep 2021-Sep 2026); convertible mark pegged to the euro (ECB 2% target)
inflation_projection.note: The euro peg anchors inflation near euro-area rates in the long run, but recent inflation has run well above them, so 3.5% is used for planning.

policy_rate.note: The Central Bank of BiH runs a currency board pegged to the euro and sets no policy interest rate.

savings_account_rate.note: CBBH interest-rate statistics are only in its login-only statistics portal and its bulletins could not be downloaded; no current savings account rate was found.

fdr_3m_rate.note: No current 3-month term deposit rate was found; CBBH interest-rate statistics are only in its login-only statistics portal.

fdr_1y_rate.note: No current 1-year term deposit rate was found; CBBH interest-rate statistics are only in its login-only statistics portal.

dps_rate.note: No published rate for a monthly recurring deposit product was found.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI FR.INR.DPST (deposit interest rate)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: 1.89% in 2025 (1.61% in 2024), per World Bank via Trading Economics as well.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: No government savings certificate or retail savings bond for individuals exists at state or entity level that we could find.

tbill_91d_rate.note: Entity governments (FBiH, RS) issue treasury bills by stock-exchange auction, but no current 3-month yield was found.

tbond_5y_rate.note: No current 5-year entity government bond yield was found.

tbond_10y_rate.note: No 10-year government bond yield was found; there is no state-level bond market and entity bonds trade thinly.

tax_bank_interest.note: PwC Tax Summaries (reviewed 23 Sep 2026) give flat income tax of 10% (FBiH) and 8% (RS) but do not say how bank interest is taxed, and no official page on it was readable.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: No government savings certificate exists, and the tax treatment of interest on entity government securities was not found.

deposit_insurance_limit.sourceName: Deposit Insurance Agency of BiH, Decision on the amount of insured deposit
deposit_insurance_limit.note: KM 100,000 per depositor per member bank, set by the decision published in Official Gazette of BiH no. 75/26; effective date not shown on the page.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: No legal cap and no published average credit card rate were found; CBBH interest-rate statistics are only in its login-only portal.

equity_return_low.sourceName: SASX-10 index 1,476 (29 Oct 2026), down from 9,854 in April 2007
equity_return_low.note: Low case for global equities in euro terms over a weak decade; the local market is too small and illiquid to plan with.

equity_return_base.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.89% (2025); SASX-10 index record
equity_return_base.note: Based on a global index in euro terms (the mark is pegged to the euro), kept about 2.5 points above the deposit rate because the local SASX-10 has lost 85% since 2007.

equity_return_high.sourceName: SASX-10 index record; global equity long-run returns in euro terms
equity_return_high.note: High case near long-run global equity returns in euro terms.

gold_return_low.sourceName: CBBH exchange rate KM 1.750653 per US dollar (KM 1.95583 per euro), 31 Oct 2026
gold_return_low.note: Low case: weak dollar gold price and a stronger euro (and mark).

gold_return_base.sourceName: CBBH exchange rate KM 1.750653 per US dollar (KM 1.95583 per euro), 31 Oct 2026
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 4-5% with no expected trend in the euro-pegged mark against the dollar.

gold_return_high.sourceName: CBBH exchange rate KM 1.750653 per US dollar (KM 1.95583 per euro), 31 Oct 2026
gold_return_high.note: High case with strong dollar gold and a weaker euro.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case: savings and short deposits paying well under the average deposit rate.

fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case a little under the average deposit rate to allow for any tax on interest.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case: longer term deposits paying above the average rate.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: The insurance agencies (BiH, FBiH, RS) publish premium and claims statistics but no life claim settlement ratio that we could find.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: No published per-1,000 term life premium table by age was found; life insurance in BiH is mostly savings-type policies quoted individually.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: No published typical out-of-pocket cost for one major private hospital stay was found.

health_premium_table.note: No age-banded private health insurance premium table was found.

oop_health_share.note: Out-of-pocket share 31.0% of current health expenditure. Latest World Bank year is 2023 (older than 2025).

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: BHAS CPI time series: health division up 5.8% (Sep 2026 vs Sep 2025)
goal_inflation_health.note: Health prices rose faster than headline CPI in the past year, so the 3.5% projection plus one point is used.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: BHAS CPI time series: education division up 2.3% (Sep 2026 vs Sep 2025)
goal_inflation_education.note: Education prices rose less than headline CPI, so the 3.5% projection is used.

life_expectancy.note: Men 74.6, women 81.1; UN WPP 2024 (via populationpyramid.net) gives 78.4 for 2026. Latest World Bank year is 2024 (older than 2025).

life_table_remaining.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024 via populationpyramid.net
life_table_remaining.note: Secondary source of UN WPP 2024 medium variant for the year 2026 (asOf set to mid-year); totals at 60, 70 and 80 are the mean of men and women (only the 65 total is published there).

support_ratio.sourceName: World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL (2025); UN WPP 2024 via populationpyramid.net (2040, 2065)
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 35.6 (2025, World Bank), 49.2 (2040) and 67.1 (2065, populationpyramid.net/bosnia-and-herzegovina/2065/).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: Federal Pension and Disability Insurance Institute (FZ MIO/PIO), pensioners
retirement_age_default.note: FBiH old-age pension at 65 with at least 15 years of insurance (or 20 years of pension service), or at any age after 40 years of insurance; same for men and women and for anyone born after 1975. Republika Srpska also uses 65 (not checked on an official RS page).

retirement_age_government.sourceName: Federal Pension and Disability Insurance Institute (FZ MIO/PIO), pensioners
retirement_age_government.note: Civil servants are in the same entity pension systems and retire on the same age-65 rule; no separate public-service pension age was found.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case: mostly sight and savings deposits.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case kept below the average deposit rate, the best available stand-in for the 1-year deposit rate, to allow for tax.

retirement_return_high.note: High case: longer term deposits and entity bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.89%; SASX-10 index
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: Low case for a balanced mix if shares lag.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: World Bank deposit rate 1.89%; equity base 4.5% (global index in euro terms)
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: Base case: roughly half global shares at 4.5% and half deposits at about 1.5%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Global equity in euro terms; SASX-10 index
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: High case for a growth-leaning balanced mix.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: No non-contributory (social) old-age pension was found in either entity; older people without a pension rely on means-tested social assistance.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: No non-contributory old-age pension was found, so there are no eligibility rules to report.

gratuity_rule.note: No statutory end-of-service gratuity in days of wages per year of service was found; severance in the entity labour laws applies to dismissal, and retirement payments are set by collective agreements.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: Federal Pension and Disability Insurance Institute (FZ MIO/PIO), pensioners
public_pension_scheme.note: Contributory pay-as-you-go pensions run by each entity (FZ MIO/PIO in FBiH, PIO Fund in RS). In FBiH, pensions are adjusted every 1 January and 1 July by a blend of consumer prices and gross wages (60/40 or 40/60), and are not cut when the blend is negative.

dps.note: No standard fixed-rate monthly recurring deposit product was found.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: No retail savings bond for individuals at state or entity level.

tbill_91d.note: Sold by stock-exchange auction, mainly to banks.

tbond_5y.note: Listed on the Sarajevo and Banja Luka stock exchanges; thinly traded.

equity_fund.note: A few local funds exist; the local stock market is small and illiquid.

gold.note: Physical gold can be bought legally.

centralBank.name: Central Bank of Bosnia and Herzegovina

insuranceRegulator.name: Insurance Supervision Agency of the Federation of BiH (Republika Srpska: Insurance Agency of RS)

insuranceComplaints.name: Insurance Ombudsman (Insurance Supervision Agency of FBiH)

pensionScheme.name: Federal Pension and Disability Insurance Institute (FZ MIO/PIO)

publicHealthCover.name: Health Insurance and Reinsurance Institute of the Federation of BiH (ZZOR FBiH)
publicHealthCover.note: Republika Srpska: Health Insurance Fund of RS.

depositInsurance.name: Deposit Insurance Agency of Bosnia and Herzegovina

statistics.name: Agency for Statistics of Bosnia and Herzegovina (BHAS)
